description: Answers any question that needs the live web: "latest news on X", "who makes Y", "documentation for Z". Returns ranked results (title, URL, snippet, date), a direct answer or knowledge-panel summary when the search engine shows one, and related searches. Filter by country, language and recency (past day, week, month, year). To read the pages too, use web_search_read (search plus the top pages as clean Markdown in one call) or scrape_markdown on a result. No results is an error and not charged. You are only charged when a result is returned: invalid input (400) and upstream failures (4xx/5xx) are not settled. Costs $0.006 USDC per call via x402. Paid per call with x402 inside MCP (see the server instructions).

country.description: Two-letter country for local results, e.g. us, gb, de. Default: us.

language.description: Two-letter language code, e.g. en, de, fr.

query.description: What to search for, e.g. "best open-source vector database 2026" or "site:sec.gov Apple 10-K".

time_range.description: Only results from the past day, week, month or year (news, recent events).

via.description: Optional: the tool whose next_calls suggested this call (filled in for you).

name: web_search
title: Web search
